text:
sam: Morning! Weekend poll: sunrise gravel loop (rough 40km, coffee stop) vs art gallery crawl + long brunch? :bike: vs :art:
nina: Gravel loop for me. Need to blow the cobwebs out. Who's leading pace?
harry: Gallery crawl sounds chill. Also, new vegan place near the gallery does an unreal tofu scramble. :yum:
lila: I'm torn. Can we do a short ride then meet for brunch? Low-effort compromise. :shrug:
omar: Short ride -> brunch is my vote. Can still do sunrise if people want early start. Also, I have one extra rack for a bike if anyone needs to bring theirs by car.
sam: Quick logistics: sunrise ride meetup 6:15am at River Park lot, route is mostly gravel with one paved stretch. Estimated back by 9:30. Brunch plan: meet 11:30 at Sunbeam Gallery, then walk to "Fiddle & Fork" for 12:30 reservations.
nina: Route snippet if anyone wants to check elevation:
```
Start: River Park lot
Climb: 120m over 8km
Coffee stop: Halfway Farmstand (~km20)
Finish: River Park lot ~9:30
```
harry: Love that. If I do gallery-only I'll aim for the 11:30 meet. Lila, do you want me to book the 12:30 for 6 people?
lila: Yes please @harry. Make it 6. Also can someone bring a spare lock? I've got one but it's old. :lock:
omar: I can bring a lock and a pump. Also tagging @here in case more folks want to join.
sam: Vote tally: gravel-only -> :one:, gallery-only -> :two:, ride+brunch -> :three:. Quick thumbs in thread?
nina: :three:
harry: :three: (unless gallery-only crowds out the reservation)
lila: :three:
omar: :three:
sam: Looks like ride+brunch wins. I'll drop a short Google Sheet for carpool & seats later tonight. See you all Saturday! :sun_with_face:
